# Lab 6.12: Find & Disable Unused Service Account Keys

## What We Are Going to Do
Find user-managed keys, check when they were last used, disable an unused one, and block new keys with an org policy.

## Steps

1. **Create a key to practise on.** Only for this lab.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create key-lab-sa
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create key.json \
  --iam-account=key-lab-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **List user-managed keys.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts keys list \
  --iam-account=key-lab-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --managed-by=user</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Check when keys were last used.** Activity Analyzer shows the last authentication time for every key.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud policy-intelligence query-activity \
  --activity-type=serviceAccountKeyLastAuthentication \
  --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A key with no recent activity is a candidate to disable. A new key can take a while to appear.

4. **Disable the key, then delete it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID \
  --iam-account=key-lab-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID \
  --iam-account=key-lab-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet
rm key.json</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Block new keys.** Go to **IAM & Admin → Organization policies**, search `Disable service account key creation` and enforce it on the project. Try creating a key again. It fails.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts delete key-lab-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| User-managed keys | Listed with `--managed-by=user` |
| Disable | Reversible, safe first step |
| Org policy | Blocks new key creation |
| Better option | Impersonation or Workload Identity Federation |
